name: fisme-sigoa
description: Sistema Integrado de Gestion de Objetivos Educacionales y Atributos del Graduado (EPIS UNTRM)

scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm db:generate && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm build:shared && pnpm db:generate && pnpm -r --if-present test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm build:shared && pnpm db:generate && pnpm -r --if-present test:coverage
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:shared && pnpm db:generate && pnpm --filter frontend test:e2e
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm db:generate && pnpm -r --if-present build
